summary: {librarian} checks whether a patron can pull up to the computer as well as reach the keys.
realLife: The Los Banos Library inspection found too little knee clearance under the public computer table.
gates: An accessible workstation review includes the table used by patrons.
inGame: needs: the workstation identifier and measured space under its table.

turns.what: The librarian clears it before the user tries again.
turns.pulledBy: Equipment stored beneath the replacement table blocks the opening.
turns.writesBack: The workstation check records the obstruction removed.

turns.what: The librarian measures a different table.
turns.pulledBy: The tabletop itself sits too low.
turns.writesBack: The equipment request includes the needed clearance.
